nom: Banila Co Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask

avis.titre: Gentle Entry-Level Retinol Sleeping Mask with Encapsulated Delivery
avis.texte: The BANILA CO Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask (100 ml) is positioned as a beginner-friendly retinol treatment combining liposomal retinol and bakuchiol capsules. At $24.99, it sits in an accessible price tier for an overnight treatment. I would rate this 4 out of 5 stars. It performs well as a mild resurfacing and smoothing mask, though those seeking aggressive retinoid-level correction may find it subtle. Texture & Application The cream has a rich, cushiony consistency typical of Korean overnight masks. It spreads evenly and absorbs without leaving a heavy occlusive film. The bakuchiol capsules visibly melt into the skin during application, which helps evenly distribute the actives. There is a noticeable rose scent. It is not overpowering, but fragrance-sensitive users should be aware. Performance The liposomal retinol appears formulated for gradual release, which makes it tolerable for sensitive or first-time retinol users. I did not experience peeling or irritation when used as directed. Results after consistent use: • Skin texture appears smoother • Mild improvement in overall tone uniformity • Skin feels more supple by morning • No pore congestion observed The inclusion of bakuchiol and ceramide contributes to moisture retention, which offsets typical retinol dryness. This makes it suitable for those easing into retinoids. That said, this is not a high-strength retinol product. Users accustomed to prescription-strength retinoids or higher-percentage formulations

avis.titre: Gentle Retinol Sleeping Mask, Hydrating, Smooths Skin with Soft Overnight Results
avis.texte: This is one of those products that leans more into comfort and consistency than intensity, which honestly makes it really easy to keep in a routine long term. I’ve been using it for a few weeks now, and it feels much more like a rich overnight treatment cream than a traditional “mask.” The texture was the first thing that stood out. It has that creamy, slightly cushiony feel that spreads easily but still feels substantial on the skin. Even though it’s on the richer side, it doesn’t feel greasy or suffocating, and it settles in well enough that it’s comfortable to sleep in without feeling like it’s just sitting on top of your skin. By morning, the most noticeable difference for me is how my skin feels. It’s consistently softer, more hydrated, and smoother when I wake up, especially in areas where I tend to get a little dehydrated. That overnight plumpness shows up right away, and with regular use a few nights a week, my skin has started to look a bit more even and refined in texture rather than dramatically changed. For context, my skin leans normal but dehydrated and can be a little sensitive depending on the formula, especially with actives. This has felt very manageable for me as a retinol product. I didn’t experience the usual dryness or peeling I sometimes associate with stronger formulas, which makes it feel like a more approachable option if you’re not looking for something aggressive. That said, I do still treat it like a retinol and use it a few nights a week instead

I’m very well versed in using tretinoin, so I found this Banila Co mask to be super gentle. If you have sensitive skin or you’re just starting out with retinoids, this would be a gentle product to try. It’s a thick, gel-like cream, and a little goes a long way. Looking at the ingredients, it uses a mix of retinol and bakuchiol, but they’re balanced out by things like allantoin, ceramide np, and panthenol. It also has macadamia nut seed oil and cholesterol, which explains why it feels so moisturizing. It didn't cause any irritation, which makes sense given how far down the list the retinol actually sits. One thing to note: it does contain fragrance. I’m not a fan of scents in my skincare, but it isn't a dealbreaker here. If you’re looking for a hardcore treatment, this isn't it, but it's a good choice for a subtle firming effect without the peeling. I’m including the full ingredients since they’re not available on here: purified water, propanediol, butylene glycol, hydrogenated polydecene, cetyl ethylhexanoate, polyglyceryl-3 methylglucose distearate, cetearyl alcohol, 1,2-hexanediol, dimethicone, methyl gluceth-20, polybutene, stearic acid, glyceryl stearate, tromethamine, carbomer, phytosterol, arachidyl alcohol, allantoin, hydrogenated lecithin, behenyl alcohol, macadamia nut seed oil, caprylic/capric triglyceride, xanthan gum, arachidyl glucoside, adenosine, polysorbate 20, retinol, fragrance, disodium edta, glycerin, rapeseed sterol, cholesterol, trehalose, mulberry flowe

I ordered this BANILA CO Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask because I really wanted an overnight retinol treatment specifically to help with my skin texture. I have had such good experiences with other K-beauty products in this price range, so I felt pretty confident giving this one a try. The texture is rich but not heavy. It feels like a true sleeping mask, something that sits comfortably on the skin without feeling greasy or suffocating. I apply it as the last step in my nighttime routine, using a thin, even layer across my face. It spreads easily and has a smooth, cushiony feel that makes it pleasant to use before bed. What I appreciate most is how gentle it has been on my skin. Retinol can sometimes be tricky for me, especially if the formula is too strong or not well-balanced. This one uses liposomal retinol, and I have not experienced the tightness or irritation that I have felt with other retinol products in the past. My skin feels calm and hydrated when I wake up instead of dry or sensitive. The bakuchiol capsule component is also a nice touch. You can feel it melt into the skin as you apply it, and by morning my face looks smoother and more refined. After a few weeks of consistent use, I have noticed that my overall texture looks more even and my skin feels more resilient to the touch. avis.titre: Comfortable overnight mask, not very hydratingComfortable overnight mask, not very hydrating
avis.texte: If you have very sensitive skin, or are especially sensitive to fragrance, then I would avoid this mask. It has a very heavy rose scent. Other than this I feel like this is a great quality mask for the price point! My skin is mildly sensitive and dry, I typically go for sensitive or fragrance free products but this one has been working well for me. A lot of products do turn my face instantly bright red and cause a lot of pain and discomfort, despite the fragrance, this mask is till comfortable and effective! For an overnight mask I normally use the eminence organics bamboo age corrective, this Banilla Co mask is a good low cost alternative. It dries quickly, does not feel sticky or tacky when trying to sleep with it on, and rinses off easily in the morning leaving my skin feeling soft and plump. I do still need to apply a moisturizer after rinsing this mask off, it doesn't seem to keep my skin hydrated for very long. I've been using it about once a week for a month, it's a great addition to my weekly routine or when I feel like I want a little extra pampering!

avis.titre: Thick and effective fast-acting night maskThick and effective fast-acting night mask
avis.texte: I've always been a huge fan of Banila Co products and this overnight mask is no exception. They're formulated so well and always smell amazing. While the brand sometimes feels like it's marketed to teens, the ingredients in this cream feel very grown-up. Retinol is definitely for more mature skin and is exactly what I need! I’m in my late 30s with combo skin, and a main concern for me is preventing fine lines and hydration. I don't tolerate tretinoin super well, even though it doesn’t stop me from trying, so it’s awesome to have this cream as an alternative. The texture is super thick and creamy but it still spreads nice and evenly. I actually tried it on top of my tret the other day and it worked surprisingly well. My skin was incredibly smooth the next morning and I haven't even experienced any of the peeling I usually get with tret. It fits in seamlessly to my routine and doesn't pill at all even with layering it over five other products. I'm super stoked to see the results after a month of use, if I’m already loving its effects after just a few days. My skin is like a skating rink in the morning. It's officially my new nightly go-to. Overall, this mask is a fantastic choice if you want the benefits of retinol without the harsh irritation. It delivers effective anti-aging ingredients in a gentle and moisturizing formula that feels luxurious and gives fast results.

avis.titre: An overnight mask that seems more like a moisturizerAn overnight mask that seems more like a moisturizer
avis.texte: This cream, a sleeping mask, has been a simple, but great addition to my nighttime beauty routine. Which is pretty minimal, just cleaning off face then adding moisturizer. Wanted something a little more restorative for my skin. And this cream seems to be a great one - just as if hoped as it is a Korean beauty product. Which I started to equate with quality. This has retinol in it, which was already known to be beneficial for my skin; and it also has Bakuchiol Capsule - which I really have no idea what that is, but did read it was plant based. And helps with skin elasticity and wrinkles. Which my skin does look more youthful and smooth. I do want to say this is a mask. Which it clearly says. But I was using more like a moisturizer. Rubbing it in and going to bed. Then going on with my morning. Apparently it's supposed to be rinsed off in the morning! I read this later after using for over a week. I guess the mornings I showered, this would've been rinsed off. But the off days I didn't shower, this was left on. I didn't notice anything. As it blends, absorbs in beautifully. Nothing left on the surface as I normally associate with a mask. Oh well. I still love it. Has a soft sweet scent that smells soothing. Comes with a little spatula to help get it out. And inner disk seal. Good way to unwind, prep for bed, while pampering your skin. 3.3 ounces- a bit larger tub than much more pricier retinol facial creams. Seems a good price point especially considering it's K beauty.

avis.titre: gentle, smoothing, hydrating, and great texture, but too fragranced to truly love it
avis.texte: I use and love the Banila Co overnight soothing mask, and I appreciate a good retinol, so I ordered this thinking I would love it. I do like it a lot, but it isn't quite love. This has a rich but non-greasy cream texture, and isn't a "mask" in the sense that it will dry to a film to peel off or a thick clay-like texture. This is creamy, absorbs well into skin, acts as a deep treatment, and is designed to be rinsed off in the morning. I really like masks like this for sleeping, because I don't do well with worrying about an actual mask staying on my face as I sleep. This really does produce good results in terms of smoothing and hydrating without drying. It feels like it is not at all a strong retinol, which would likely make it a good choice for those new to or more sensitive to retinols; on the other hand, more experienced users may not get enough of a retinoid effect. For me, this is a good way to give my skin a break from stronger actives and soak in some quality hydrators and emollients. The reason it isn't true love? This is so strongly fragranced to me. I already don't like most florals, but can tolerate a great product with a floral scent if it is lighter or not lingering. On me, the fragrance in this doesn't seem to fade. Since it's a nighttime treatment it isn't nearly as bad, but I will say that the strength/longevity of this fragrance would not work for me in a product I used during the day and remained conscious to experience. I still really appreciate the texture

avis.titre: Super nice gel/cream hybrid sleeping mask moisturizer for night time
avis.texte: I absolutely love korean skincare and I consider myself a bit of a high-end skincare connoisseur. This BANILA sleeping mask does NOT disappoint. I'm guessing it does not have a high concentration of retinoids so I'm not expecting a strong outcome from the actives but I would say in the past week of using it, my pores do look tighter and no breakouts. The ceramides seem to be the heavy lifter because it has that creamy/gel ceramide consistency that I tend to really really love. It's a lovely night time moisturizer because it leaves your skin feeling like it took a nice big drink without stifling it. It reminds me of some of the other k-skincare gel moisturizers I've used. I haven't tested it under makeup yet but I have a hunch it would definitely sit nice over this moisturizer (even though it says it's a sleeping mask) given the consistency. It has a faint fragrance that's quite nice. The jar is a generous volume for the value point and I love that they include the little spatula so you don't contaminate the product, something korean skincare brands often do and I really enjoy. Would repurchase. I look forward to trying more Banila products if they're as good as this sleeping mask.

avis.titre: I hope you like rose scented products
avis.texte: This mask is, like everything else from Banila, a solid well priced sleeping mask. The rose scent is a little overwhelming, and if used as a sleeping mask, if you don't love rose, you may find it hard to sleep with this on your face. I wouldn't use this if your skin isn't super accustomed to retinols, since this has both lipsome retinol AND bakuchiol in it, which are both retinols. Two retinols PLUS all of the added fragrance could be way too much irritation for sensitive skin not accustomed to retinols. Aside from the super strong rose scent, this is a nice sleeping mask. It goes on very thick and luxurious, but as I was applying it and it emulsified it kind of broke down into a thinner consistency, which was interesting to me. My house is very dry and my skin usually feels PARCHED in the morning. I felt slightly hydrated upon waking up. I didn't notice any "firming" effects, but I did like the little extra hydration. I will continue to use this in hopes that firming is something that could actually happen (looking at the ingredients I'm not sure how firming is supposed to occur).

avis.titre: Little Goes a Looonng Way, Nice Scent.
avis.texte: This sleeping mask comes in a decent sized container, and has a divider tray that you have to pull out to use the product. Normally I find this a pain, and toss the divider, but the included spatula does fit inside pretty well, so I'll keep it. This mask has a lotion like consistentancy and applies like a lotion as well. There's no mask like quality to it, and it feels like it nearly fully absorbs. It leaves sort of soft sheen feel left on the skin that doesn't feel greasy. This mask has a lighter soft floral scent, and I don't really notice that it transfers to my skin. It doesn't take much at all to completely cover my face and neck, so this tub will last quite a long time. I was worried with it being more lotion like, that it would cause my oily skin to become even more unhinged, but it feels like it's calming my sebum overproduction. My skin has been baby soft too. If I use this every night, my skin does get a little oily by morning, but every other day seems to be the sweet spot for me.

avis.titre: Gentle retinol that firms without irritation
avis.texte: My wife is a big fan of this brand, and this sleeping mask lives up to that reputation. She’s been using it regularly for several weeks and has had a consistently positive experience. She’s not new to retinol, and this feels like a very gentle formula. No redness, peeling, or breakouts. It absorbs well overnight, isn’t greasy, and leaves her skin feeling moisturized rather than heavy. By morning, her skin feels noticeably smoother and firmer, not just temporarily hydrated. The rose scent is very light and pleasant, not overpowering. At $25 for 100ml, it feels fairly priced, and she plans to repurchase when it runs out.

avis.titre: Scent is a little strong, but works great.
avis.texte: I’ve never tried an overnight mask before so I thought I’d give this Banila Co. Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask a try. I’m in my mid 40s and very familiar with retinol so I figured this would be a a good fit for me. Adding this product to my nightly routine was rather easy. I do my skincare routine as normal, but then I add this cream on at the end with the little included spatula to make a type of seal or mask layer to help keep my applied serums and moisturizer from drying out. Not to mention the retinol and Bakuchiol in this mask helps my skin too. Once this mask layer dries, it only forms a thin layer on my skin. Plus once dried I don’t have to worry about my flyaway hairs getting stuck in it while I sleep. After rinsing off the mask with warm water in the morning, I’ve been noticing my skin feeling more moisturized and just overall looking better. I’ve also had no bad skin reactions since I started using this mask, but I did start out slowly by only using it twice a week at first. The only downside I found from using the overnight mask was the scent. The floral smell is a little too strong for my liking. But in the end I am glad I ordered this Banila Co. Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask. It’s made a difference with how my skin looks and feels in the morning in just a short amount of time. I just wish the scent wasn’t so strong. Hoping for an unscented version in the future!

avis.titre: Leaves my face smelling great and moisturized.
avis.texte: BANILA CO Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask . This cream is not greasy.A little cream goes a long way. I put at night time after washing my face and then I removed in the morning with a rinse just like the instructions says. This cream smell like roses so is a good thing because nobody wants to go to bed with bad smells around. So far I noticed my dry skin being moisturized. This cream gave me zero side effects like rash or red spot etc. This item does the job right. This product makes a great gift present for a lady that cares about her face health. This item is great value for the money and affordable.This product is as described. This item seem like good quality ingredients in it because of the texture and great smell. I recommend this product.

I really like this sleeping mask and trust BANILA CO as a Korean skincare brand. The formula feels rich and nourishing without being heavy or greasy. I love that it combines liposomal retinol with bakuchiol capsules. This gives the skin the benefits of retinol while being gentle enough for sensitive or acne-prone skin. The mask absorbs nicely overnight, leaving my skin feeling soft and smooth by morning. The formula is vegan, non-comedogenic, and the added ceramides and hyaluronic acid make it very moisturizing. It’s ideal for anyone looking to improve skin texture and firmness without irritation. For a high-quality Korean skincare mask that works while you sleep, this one is definitely worth trying, and the price.

This overnight sleeping mask is really just a deep moisturizing, thick cream that feels so silky when you put it on. My skin really feels smooth and silky soft after using it. It smells like rose, so if you're not a fan of old fashioned scents like rose or lilac, you might not like this so much, but I like the natural scent. It's a nice smooth creamy texture, and the container is quite large, so this will last a long time. I feel like it's a great value for the money for a retinol moisturizer and I'm very happy with the results so far.

This overnight firming retinol sleeping mask is AMSING and locking in moisture and waking up with plump hydrated skin! I had no issues with the active ingredient of retinol on my face and very much appreciated the light and sensitive skin like cream that this is! A little goes a long way and I have noticed my skin becoming more hydrated and much less dry! I make sure to keep sunscreen on the next day to protect my skin but for someone who doesn’t use retinol, this did the trick and I would highly recommend!
